name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.212: "Check support" on the Advanced tab (Who converts video). It compares every movie and episode on this server and in friends' libraries with what common players (browsers, Android TV, phones, Apple, Roku, Samsung/LG, desktop apps) play as stored, and lists which file types need converting on which players. Read-only. Also fixes the Advanced tab's "Open all sections" button, which did nothing.
